description: Source file for PricingServiceClient class, an HTTP client component that interacts with the pricing service to resolve product prices, propagating JWT tokens and handling exceptions.

classes.name: PricingServiceClient
classes.description: A client component using Spring WebClient to communicate with the pricing service API, including methods to resolve price and handle related exceptions.

methods.name: resolvePrice
methods.description: Builds and sends a GET request to the pricing service to obtain pricing info for a SKU, propagating authentication token, handling errors.

methods.name: normalizeCurrency
methods.description: Utility method to trim and uppercase currency codes, returns null if input is null or blank.

classes.name: PricingServiceClient.PricingServiceClientException
classes.description: Runtime exception class for signaling errors calling the pricing service.
